name: Moodle Web Services
tagline: Open-source LMS REST web services for course, user, and grade integration
description: Moodle Web Services expose each Moodle site's LMS data and actions over REST (and SOAP/XML-RPC where enabled). Integrators call site-specific endpoints with a user token to manage users, enrolments, courses, grades, and more. There is no single public SaaS API—every deployment is self-hosted or hosted by a Moodle partner; availability, limits, and tokens are per site.

auth.details: Web service token (wstoken query or form field) issued per user/service in Site administration; optional OAuth 2 for some flows. Self-serve only on your own Moodle instance.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free open-source software; no vendor API quota—limits are per site/hosting
pricing.paid_plans: MoodleCloud and Moodle partners offer paid hosting; core web services are free with Moodle

rate_limits: not published (site/admin configurable; no global Moodle.org quota)
use_cases: list courses on a Moodle site
create or update LMS users from an SIS
fetch grades or grade items for a course
get site info and available web service functions
